about: Phrases that chat models of a given period over-used relative to human writing. Every list here expires: a new model generation drops most of the old phrases and brings its own. Use the lists to find places to look, never as a ban list, and refresh them with `humanize.py lexicon HUMAN AI` on current samples.

entries.source: Wikipedia 'Signs of AI writing' (GPT-4 era list); HAP-E corpus, GPT-4o vs human academic text (share of documents 0% -> 7-50%)
This project's corpus: 279 journal papers from 2024 vs 417 from 2018-19, same journals (share of papers 0-2% -> 8-25%)
This project's corpus: 238 journal papers from May-November 2026 vs 417 from 2018-19, same journals (share of papers 0-3% -> 9-40%)
This project's corpus: Claude Haiku 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 writing paper sections from notes vs the human originals (0-1% -> 10-29%); Graphite 'AI tells' study, Sept 2026; Wikipedia mid-2026 list

human_plain.about: Plain phrases that human papers used far more than current models do (share of 2018-19 papers -> share of 2026 papers or model drafts). A rewrite should not strip these, and may use them where they fit. They are not decorations to sprinkle in.
